title: PNG text chunk carla:sensor, format version 1
description: The camera platform's pose and pinhole intrinsics at the capture, the same values the truth sidecar's platform event carries. A still with no platform pose carries no chunk. This schema describes format version 1; a chunk with no format_version was written before chunks carried one and is version 1.

format_version.description: The chunk's format version. Absent from a chunk written before chunks carried one, which is version 1.

uid.description: The camera's track identifier, such as CARLA-SENSOR-107.

type.description: The camera platform's Cursor-on-Target air-track type, such as a-f-A-M-F-Q.

callsign.description: The camera's name, which every still of the camera is named after.

hae.description: The camera's height above the WGS84 ellipsoid in the bare-earth convention every vehicle's height uses: its physical height less align_offset_m.

align_offset_m.description: The height-align offset under the camera, taken off its physical height: physical height = hae + align_offset_m.

az_deg.description: Boresight azimuth, clockwise from true north.

course_deg.description: Direction of the camera's movement over the ground since the previous capture, clockwise from true north; the boresight azimuth when it moved slower than 0.5 m/s.

speed_mps.description: The camera's ground speed since the previous capture.

intrinsics.description: The camera's pinhole intrinsics: square pixels, the principal point at the picture's center.

fy.description: Focal length down; equal to fx.

vfov_deg.description: Vertical field of view, from the height and the focal length.

distortion.description: The lens distortion: none at CARLA's defaults, otherwise CARLA's own lens parameters.

sensor_model.description: The camera blueprint, such as sensor.camera.rgb.
